facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of downtown Calgary.
facts.excerpt: Conveniently located in the heart of downtown Calgary

facts.text: The hotel is within easy reach of shopping, cultural venues, the Calgary Tower and the Calgary Zoo.
facts.excerpt: within easy reach of premium shopping, cultural venues, exciting events, and attractions like the Calgary Tower and Calgary Zoo

facts.text: Fairmont Gold is a private lounge level with a complimentary continental breakfast each morning and evening canapes.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy exclusive access to our private Fairmont Gold Lounge, featuring a complimentary deluxe continental breakfast each morning and elegant evening canapés.

facts.text: Hawthorn Dining Room & Bar serves modern prairie fare.

facts.text: Hawthorn hosts live music on Thursday, Friday and Saturday.

facts.text: The hotel has rnr Wellness spa.
